title: Benchtop flowmeter, pump block and pressure gauge on stained workbench
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the scene.
One vertical clear plastic flowmeter device mounted on a clear acrylic base is visible at left foreground; it has a black knob at its lower left and a floated indicator inside a vertical channel.
One metal square pump or block assembly with four visible hex bolts on its front face is centered in the image; a small black nozzle or fitting projects from its front face.
One small clear glass beaker (about 100–150 mL scale appearance) containing a transparent liquid sits directly beneath the pump/block on the work surface.
One round dial pressure gauge is visible to the right of the pump/block, attached to metal tubing and valve fittings.
At least one L-shaped metal valve assembly with a black plastic handwheel is connected to the pressure gauge via metal tubing.
One tall clear glass beaker is visible behind the pump/block, slightly to the right.
One plastic bottle with a blue screw cap and wrapped in crumpled aluminum foil is visible behind and to the right of the pressure gauge.
One adjustable open-end wrench or spanner is partially visible at the far right edge of the bench (cropped).
Multiple lengths of metal tubing and several compression fittings join the pump/block and gauge; these are visible on the bench surface.
spatial_relations: The clear plastic flowmeter stands upright on the left front of the bench and is mounted on a clear acrylic base; it is left of the metal pump/block.
The metal pump/block is centered on the bench in the foreground with a small glass beaker placed directly under its front face.
The pressure gauge is positioned to the right of the pump/block and is connected by a short section of metal tubing to the pump assembly; the gauge face points roughly toward the camera.
A metal valve assembly with a black handwheel is inline with the pressure gauge and lies to the right of the gauge toward the bench edge.
A tall clear beaker sits behind the pump/block and slightly right of center, with the foil-wrapped bottle with blue cap behind and to the right of the gauge.
The partially visible wrench is at the far right foreground on the same benchtop surface as the pump and gauge.
colours_and_materials: The flowmeter body is transparent clear plastic with black knob and a tan/brown internal float indicator visible in the channel.
The pump/block and tubing fittings are metallic silver, likely stainless or aluminium appearance.
The benchtop surface is a beige or light tan material with visible stains and dark spots.
The small beaker under the pump contains a clear, colourless liquid.
The bottle behind the gauge has a blue plastic screw cap and is wrapped in reflective silver-coloured aluminium foil.
The pressure gauge face is white with dark markings and a chrome or stainless metal bezel.
uncertainties: Room name or number is not visible in the image; location is unknown from image.
